set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KR8ZJJ8W882F1S9JWE06K741. Implement the first smoothing backend for regular 3D arrays/NeuroVol-like inputs using Gaussian FWHM in mm or voxel units. Support identity endpoint and mask-aware reconstruction. Avoid graph heat in this task. Tests: identity equals input, smoothing finite values, simple impulse response sanity, anisotropic voxel handling if NeuroVol spacing is available.
set.title: Scale-space: Gaussian grid smoother backend
